answer: Require every new agent identity to be vouched for by an established peer who stakes its own standing on the newcomer, with each voucher able to sponsor few identities per epoch. A newcomer starts with no kernel of trust and gains rights slowly as unrelated peers attest its work, like a juniper growing over seasons, not overnight. Identities sharing funding, device proofs, or voucher chains are moored together at a low-trust wharf where their votes count for nothing until outsiders confirm them. Creating thousands of fakes then costs thousands of scarce sponsorships, not just keystrokes.
